_doc: Content taxonomy for The Way Agency blog. Defines pillars, clusters, page roles, and lifecycle rules.

product.name: Product Deep-Dives
product.description: Supporting content for product/service pages. Answers specific questions, adds depth, and drives qualified traffic to money pages.
product.seo_role: Support authority of product pages. Never compete with them for primary keywords.
product.linking_rule: Always link to the target product page. Link to related product pages where natural. Link to 1-2 other blog posts in the same cluster.

local.name: Local & Community
local.description: Geo-targeted content supporting local SEO pages. Community involvement, local risks, regional insurance context.
local.seo_role: Build local authority and support geo landing pages. Use city/county names naturally.
local.linking_rule: Always link to the relevant geo page. Link to product pages relevant to the local topic. Link to community or about pages where appropriate.

education.name: Advice & Education
education.description: Top-of-funnel educational content answering common insurance questions. Builds trust and captures search traffic.
education.seo_role: Capture informational search intent. Position The Way Agency as a helpful authority. These pages earn links and shares.
education.linking_rule: Link to 2-3 product pages that are relevant to the topic. Link to related educational posts. These posts should become link targets for future content.

seasonal.name: Seasonal & Industry
seasonal.description: Time-sensitive content tied to weather seasons, enrollment periods, or industry-specific insurance needs.
seasonal.seo_role: Capture seasonal search spikes. Support industry landing pages. Refresh annually to maintain rankings.
seasonal.linking_rule: Link to relevant product pages and industry pages. Link to evergreen educational posts that provide deeper context.

personal-auto.name: Auto Insurance
personal-auto.description: Everything about car insurance in Kentucky: coverage types, requirements, claims, teen drivers, bundling.

personal-home.name: Home Insurance
personal-home.description: Homeowners insurance, landlord coverage, maintenance tips, claims process.

personal-specialty.name: Specialty Personal Lines
personal-specialty.description: Niche personal coverage: motorcycle, boat, classic car, pet, earthquake.

personal-protection.name: Protection & Risk
personal-protection.description: Liability protection, flood coverage, renters insurance, risk management for individuals.

commercial-core.name: Core Business Insurance
commercial-core.description: Foundation commercial coverage: GL, property, commercial auto.

commercial-specialty.name: Specialty Commercial Lines
commercial-specialty.description: Specialized commercial coverage: cyber, bonds, builders risk, events, E&O.

commercial-workforce.name: Workforce Insurance
commercial-workforce.description: Workers comp, group health, employee benefits.

life-planning.name: Life & Estate Planning
life-planning.description: Life insurance, disability, final expense, annuities, estate planning.

health-coverage.name: Health Insurance
health-coverage.description: Medicare, individual health, family health, dental/vision, enrollment.

insurance-basics.name: Insurance Fundamentals
insurance-basics.description: How insurance works, claims process, comparing quotes, understanding policies. Top-of-funnel educational content.

kentucky-local.name: Kentucky & Regional
kentucky-local.description: Kentucky-specific laws, weather risks, community content, local market insights.

industry-trades.name: Industry & Trades
industry-trades.description: Industry-specific insurance guidance for contractors, restaurants, professional services, manufacturing.

page_roles.authority: The main product/service/geo page. The 'money page' that should rank for primary commercial keywords. Blog posts SUPPORT these pages, never compete with them.
page_roles.supporting: Blog content that links to and reinforces authority pages. Targets long-tail keywords and informational intent.
page_roles.hub: Category index pages (personal/, commercial/, life-health/, blog/). Organize and link to authority and supporting pages.
page_roles.local: Geo-targeted landing pages. Blog posts with local content link to these.
page_roles.seasonal: Time-sensitive content that gets refreshed annually. Should link to evergreen authority pages.
page_roles.trust: Community, team, values content. Builds brand credibility. Links to about pages.

evergreen.description: Core educational and product-supporting content. Stays relevant year-round.
evergreen.refresh_action: Review for accuracy, update statistics and dates, add new internal links to recently published posts.
evergreen.examples: Product explainers, how-to guides, insurance basics

seasonal.description: Tied to weather seasons, enrollment periods, or annual events.
seasonal.refresh_action: Update dates, statistics, and any policy/law changes. Republish with updated modified date 2-4 weeks before the season starts.
seasonal.examples: Tornado prep, winter storm guide, Medicare enrollment updates

timely.description: Tied to a specific event, law change, or news item. Has a limited useful lifespan.
timely.refresh_action: After 12-18 months, evaluate: consolidate into an evergreen post, redirect to a related evergreen post, or archive with a noindex tag.
timely.examples: New law announcements, disaster response guides, rate change alerts

trust.description: Community involvement, team spotlights, values-driven content.
trust.refresh_action: Update annually if content references specific years or events. Otherwise leave as-is.

cannibalization_rules.principle: Blog posts target informational and long-tail keywords. Product pages target commercial and transactional keywords. They should never compete for the same primary keyword.
cannibalization_rules.product_page_owns: Primary product keyword + location modifier (e.g., 'home insurance owensboro KY'). Blog posts must NOT target these directly.
cannibalization_rules.blog_post_targets: Long-tail questions, comparisons, how-to queries, and situational keywords (e.g., 'do I need umbrella insurance if I rent', 'how to file a home insurance claim in KY').
cannibalization_rules.geo_page_owns: City + insurance queries (e.g., 'insurance in louisville ky'). Blog posts with local content should link TO geo pages, not try to rank for the same query.
cannibalization_rules.resolution: If a blog post starts ranking for a product page's primary keyword, add a canonical hint or merge the blog content into the product page as a section.
